evidence_receipt.claim: varnames can strip an implicit self argument from a bound method even when its qualname has no dot.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: The code explicitly checks if the function is a bound method (is_bound) or if the qualname contains a dot before stripping the first argument. This means varnames will strip the implicit self argument even if the qualname has no dot, as long as is_bound is True.
